about_the_game:
A BACKSTORY THAT GOES BEYOND THE SURFACE

To combine is to live… QUACK! This reclusive duck is on a mission. With every waddle, his determination grows. To those around him, he is an innocent bath toy. However, his plans are much more sinister. Unbeknownst to the public, he has fishnapped many residents of the local beaches. In his search for power and for the excitement of experimentation, Bubbles! is a game where YOU are the henchman of a deranged duck. Your laboratory: his bathroom. It is up to you to help this duck reach the pinnacle of combinations without overflowing his tub.

GAMEPLAY

With a humble soap dispenser, now named the Bubble Maker, take the oceanic hostages and cast them into the duck’s porcelain domain. In this tub, the duck loves to play with his bubbles for hours. When two creatures of the same type collide, they become something stronger. Something more powerful. Something exceptional. These discoveries fuel the duck’s obsession. How far can you and the duck go?

SPECIAL FEATURES

● Mysterious items that can be utilized to merge creatures or end their sorry life. ● Store creatures or items for later use by placing them in the duck’s fishnapping bag. ● Bonus points for pulling off a combination combo.

HOW MANY NEW COMBINATIONS CAN YOU DISCOVER?

The more combinations you do and the stronger the creatures you make, the higher your score will be. Can you reach a new high score? But be careful, if the tub overflows, the duck’s experiment will be ruined and he won’t get the deposit back on his apartment.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 32-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 or AMD Athlon II X2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (6th Gen) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 250 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Can you and a duck bath toy reach the peak of evolution? In this physics-based combination game featuring cute little sea creatures, merge bubbles together to create new life forms!
